name: top
purpose: Display a live, continuously updating view of running processes and CPU/memory usage.
explanation: Shows real-time CPU and memory usage for running processes. Press 'q' to quit.
expectedOutput: (Interactive live table of processes updated in real time; press q to quit)
whenToUse: To monitor live system resource usage from the terminal.
commonMistakes: Forgetting to press 'q' to exit the live view.
explanationOfOutput: Shows the simulated terminal response when running `top` in a standard Unix-like shell.
commonErrors: zsh: command not found: top (if not installed or missing from PATH)
